title: Predictive Structure Behind Rare Outcomes in Random Quantum Circuits
summary: Local random quantum circuits selected for unusually large output peaks reveal intermediate-state structure that predicts new peak formation and guides circuit construction. In one-dimensional Haar-random brickwall circuits, the selected trajectories combine stronger pairwise correlations and probability redistribution with lower bipartite entanglement and output entropy. We test the predictive value of this structure by keeping each circuit's initial segment fixed and independently regenerating the remaining gates.
